title: Laravel Senior Backend Developer (m/w/d) - Skaliere mit uns auf Millionen-Traffic
description:
Laravel trifft auf digitale Goldgräberstimmung

2 Millionen User. 1,5 Milliarden Requests. 30.000 Live-Zuschauer gleichzeitig.

Das sind unsere Zahlen. Das ist dein neuer Arbeitsplatz, wenn du Laravel wirklich beherrschst.

Die Fakten

Kettner Edelmetalle - einer der größten Edelmetallhändler Europas mit über 200.000 Kunden und dreistelligem Millionenumsatz. Unsere Laravel-Plattform muss performen - jeden Tag, jede Sekunde. Kein Spielzeug-Traffic, sondern echte Last.

Der Tech-Stack

  • Laravel als Fundament (Custom Framework)

  • PHP 8+ mit modernen Features

  • SingleStore für Performance-kritische Daten

  • ElasticSearch für Suchen & Algorithmen

  • Redis & Queues für Skalierung

  • AWS/Cloud Serverless Infrastruktur

  • Nuxt/Vue.js im Frontend (nice-to-have)

Der Job

Du entwickelst Backend-Systeme, die funktionieren müssen. Keine Proof-of-Concepts, sondern produktive Software:

  • Live-Trading-Platform: Realtime-Features für bis zu 30.000 gleichzeitige User bei Live-Events. WebSockets, Broadcasting, Performance unter Extremlast.

  • Edelmetall-Sparplan: Unser größtes aktuelles Projekt. Vollautomatisierte Sparpläne mit komplexen Berechnungen, Event-Driven Architecture.

  • E-Commerce-Backend: APIs für Millionen von Requests, komplexe Edelmetall-Transaktionen, Portfolio-Management, Live-Preise.

  • Skalierbare Architektur: Microservices entwickeln, Eloquent für große Datenmengen optimieren, Artisan Commands für Business-Prozesse.

Was du mitbringst

  • Perfekte Laravel-Kenntnisse - du weißt, wie das Framework wirklich tickt

  • High-Traffic-Erfahrung - du hast schon mal echte Last gestemmt

  • Problemlöser-Mentalität - wenn's brennt, packst du an

  • Eigenverantwortung - wir diskutieren nicht jeden Commit

Frontend-Skills (Nuxt/Vue) sind ein Plus, aber nicht entscheidend. Wir brauchen jemanden, der Backend kann.

Was du bekommst

  • 60.000 - 110.000€ je nach dem, was du drauf hast

  • MacBook Pro - vernünftiges Arbeitsgerät für jeden Entwickler

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte auf Edelmetalle

  • Modernes Office in Berlin oder Villingen-Schwenningen (auf Wunsch)

  • Flexible Arbeitsmodelle - Remote/Hybrid möglich

  • Echte technische Herausforderungen statt Standard-CRUD

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Bewerbung + GitHub-Profil (Zeig uns deine Laravel-Skills!)

  2. Coding Challenge: php artisan make:impression

  3. Tech-Interview (Fachlicher Austausch auf Augenhöhe)

  4. Team-Kennenlernen (Willkommen an Bord!)

Bewirb dich jetzt

Schick uns dein GitHub-Profil und ein aussagekräftiges Anschreiben. Lebenslauf ist optional - wir wollen sehen, was du kannst, nicht wo du warst.

Ready für echte Laravel-Herausforderungen? Dann bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil eines Teams, das täglich Millionenwerte in Edelmetallen bewegt.


Dein Stack sollte glänzen mit:

  • Tiefgehende Erfahrung in PHP und dem Framework Laravel - du kennst nicht nur die Basics, sondern weißt, wie man Laravel richtig architektiert

  • Sicherer Umgang mit SQL-Datenbanken und performanter Datenabfrage - Millionen von Requests erfordern optimierte Queries

  • Know-how in der Entwicklung skalierbarer Webanwendungen - du hast schon mal Systeme gebaut, die unter echter Last performen

  • Solide Kenntnisse in HTML5, CSS3 und JavaScript - auch als Backend-Dev solltest du das Frontend verstehen

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Git und strukturiertem Versionmanagement - sauberer Code, saubere Commits

  • Neugier und Eigenantrieb, dich in neue Technologien reinzudenken - bei uns entwickelt sich der Stack ständig weiter

  • Optional, aber gerne gesehen: Erfahrung mit Vue, Nuxt und TailwindCSS - wenn du Fullstack drauf hast, umso besser

Pluspunkt: Du kennst dich mit Laravel Filament aus - unser Backend-Framework der Wahl. Damit bauen wir unser Backend - zeig uns, ob du ein echter Tech-Nerd bist oder nur an der Oberfläche kratzt!

title: Senior Scaled Enablement Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Why we need you

Maltego helps organisations uncover complex relationships and connections across people, organisations, infrastructure, and digital assets. Our platform is used by investigators, security professionals, law enforcement agencies, and enterprises worldwide to accelerate investigations and make better decisions with connected data. As we continue to grow, we're expanding our Customer Enablement team to help more customers achieve value at scale. 
We're looking for a Senior Scaled Enablement Manager to design and lead scalable customer enablement programmes that help customers successfully adopt and expand their use of Maltego products. This role sits at the intersection of customer enablement, programme management, customer education, and product adoption. You'll create repeatable experiences that enable hundreds of customers to learn, adopt, and realise value through webinars, cohort programmes, workshops, office hours, self-service content, and usage-driven interventions. 
Rather than working with a small portfolio of strategic accounts one-to-one, your focus will be on creating programmes and systems that deliver meaningful outcomes across an entire customer segment. You'll play a key role in shaping how Maltego scales customer success and adoption as we continue to grow.


What to expect

  • Own the scaled enablement motion, designing live, repeatable programmes that drive product adoption, engagement, and value realisation.
  • Build and maintain a cohort and enablement roadmap aligned with customer needs, product priorities, and business objectives.
  • Develop and optimise repeatable scaled customer journeys that support onboarding, adoption, expansion, and re-engagement at scale.
  • Plan and deliver webinars, workshops, cohort-based training programmes, office hours, and other one-to-many customer learning experiences.
  • Create and maintain high-quality enablement content, including training materials, guides, playbooks, videos, and knowledge base resources.
  • Leverage AI and automation tools to improve programme design, content creation, customer insight generation, and operational efficiency across scaled enablement initiatives.
  • Analyse customer engagement and product adoption data, using AI-assisted insights where appropriate, to identify trends, opportunities, and targeted intervention strategies.
  • Measure and improve programme effectiveness using customer feedback, usage insights, and business performance metrics.
  • Partner closely with Account Managers, Customer Enablement SMEs, Product Management, Marketing, and Operations teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.
  • Define and evolve scalable operating models, processes, and best practices that enable customer success programmes to grow efficiently with the business.


Your profile in short

Required Qualifications (Must Have)

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in Customer Success, Customer Enablement, Customer Education, Customer-facing Programme Management, Product Adoption, Training, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role.
  • Experience designing, delivering, and improving scalable customer programmes, including webinars, cohorts, workshops, office hours, or other one-to-many formats in a SaaS or technology environment.
  • Strong presentation, facilitation, written communication, and content development skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate customer insights and usage data into actionable adoption strategies.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
  • Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken).
Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)
  • Experience with customer success, customer education, learning management, or community platforms.
  • Experience using customer success platforms such as Planhat, Gainsight, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with product adoption analytics, customer engagement metrics, and data-driven programme optimisation.
  • Experience in cybersecurity, investigations, intelligence, OSINT, SaaS, or B2B software environments.
  • Experience creating self-service learning content, structured learning paths, or customer training curricula


Why you will love Maltego

title: Senior Business Intelligence Lead (all genders)
description:
Your Mission

EV charging is evolving from a niche technology into everyday infrastructure. As reev grows, teams increasingly need reliable, consistently defined metrics. Today, different dashboards, reporting dates, filters, and assumptions can produce different answers to the same business question. 
This role addresses the problem - not by building more dashboards, but by creating a shared and trustworthy data foundation. The goal is to establish clear definitions and consistent metrics so that teams and leadership can make informed decisions based on the same numbers. Someone who understands that unclear definitions, rather than a lack of data, are often the real problem can make a significant impact in this role. You own the certified layer, the single, agreed upon version of every core metric that reev runs on. You connect the definition, the data model, and the delivery. And when two numbers disagree, you are the person who says which one to trust. 

What you will do 

  • Define core metrics with Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Engineering, and Platform.
  • Agree on definitions, data contracts, and ownership forcore metrics with the teams that own them.
  • Maintain and verify the certified data layer, built in ETL tooland surfaced in Metabase, so teams can build their own dashboards on top of it.
  • Use SQL to validate data, investigate inconsistencies, and trace numbers back to their sources.
  • Work with Platform team to identify potential improvements in data flows, pipelines, and transformations, advise on next steps, and help prioritize next steps during planning.
  • Help stakeholders decide which number to trust when reports disagree.
  • Improve data literacy through practical guidance, workshops, and clear documentation.
  • Use AI-assisted tools for analysis, documentation, automation, and workflows. Check the results carefully.
 
What this role is not 
You will not be the central owner of every dashboard request. Teams remain responsible for their own dashboards, analyses, and data models built on their data contracts. This is also not a classic infrastructure or people-management role. 



What you bring along

Must-have 

  • Senior experience in BI, analytics, or data. Scale-up experience is helpful.
  • Strong SQL skills.You can read and write SQL,validate data, and trace where a number comes from.
  • Experience defining KPIs with Finance and other business owners.
  • Experience with data models, data quality, or data governance.
  • A good understanding of data flows, pipelines, and transformations.
  • Confidence working with senior stakeholders and challenging unclear or incorrect numbers.

  • Experience with automation, AI Agents, or AI-supported workflows.

  • Experience with workshops, enablement, or data literacy programmes.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, EV charging, energy, mobility, or a related field.
You do not need every tool on the list. We care most about strong SQL, sound data thinking, and the ability to bring people to one shared definition.

Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

  • Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

  • Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

  • You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

  • You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

  • You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

  • You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

  • You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

  • You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

  • You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With

  • 2–5 years working in product design

  • Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

  • Running user research from discovery through usability testing

  • Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions

  • Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams

  • Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states

  • Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions

  • Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve

  • Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

  • Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together.

  • Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work.

  • Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment.

About the Team

Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each.

As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role.

You’ll partner most closely with:

  • Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership

  • Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context

  • Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work.

We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

title: UVC Partners: Data & AI - Master Thesis / Internship (f/m/x)
description:
About us

UVC Partners is one of Europe’s leading early-stage venture capital firms. With our fourth fund generation of €250 million, we invest in disruptive B2B startups at the seed and Series A stage across Europe. Our focus areas include enterprise software, mobility, and industrial technologies.
Headquartered in Munich and closely integrated with UnternehmerTUM, Europe’s largest entrepreneurship center, we are proud partners to some of Europe’s most ambitious founders – including Flixbus, Isar Aerospace, finn.auto, Proxima Fusion, and Aleph Alpha.

At UVC Partners, we’re driven by a deep passion for entrepreneurship and its power to positively shape society. Environmental and social responsibility are core to our DNA. We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do. As a firm, we continuously reinvent ourselves to stay ahead and best serve our portfolio and investors. We believe in ownership over hierarchy and foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and personal engagement. And while we’re serious about our mission, we also genuinely enjoy working together and building lasting relationships along the way.


Your mission

You will join a specialized team working at the intersection of applied research and venture capital, side by side with investors, AI researchers, and engineers building the backbone of our investment intelligence. This is a hands-on role with real stakes. You will be treated as a full member of the team, expected to take a research question from literature to a working prototype and to present your results to the people who make the investment decisions.


Your profile

  • You are enrolled in a Master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a similar program at a top university.
  • You bring depth, or the ambition to build it, in at least one relevant toolkit, whether that is graph ML and graph databases (e.g. PyTorch Geometric), LLM tooling, tool use and evaluation, or probabilistic modeling (e.g. PyMC, NumPyro).
  • You write clean, modular Python and have firm machine learning and statistics fundamentals.
  • You are fluent with AI-assisted coding tools and you have judgment about them. You know what they do well, where they quietly fail, and you review everything they produce. You do not ship AI slop.
  • You work independently. You have run a project where you set the direction yourself, and you can point to it.
  • You are fluent in English, including technical language. It is what you will work, write, and present in. German is helpful but not required.

How we work
We are an AI-powered development team. Everyone here codes with AI assistance, and we treat that as a craft. You need to know which parts of a problem to hand over, where these tools fail quietly, and how to review output you did not write.
Agency matters a lot in our team. You get mentorship, context, and access to everyone. You do not get someone assigning you tasks every morning. Take a rough problem statement, come back with an approach, show drafts while they can still change, and flag what is not working. What you bring should outweigh what it costs us to support you.

Potential Research Directions
These are directions we could explore, with scope defined together at the start based on your background and where the work leads.
1. With Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) we would work on a graph-structured database, where people and companies are nodes and the relationships between them are part of the data, and ask what that structure can tell us that a table cannot.
2. With Program-aided Language Models (PAL) we would have the model write a small program for every number it pulls from decks and financial statements, so figures are accurately computed, because that is what makes it safe to point a language model at financial data.
3. And with Bayesian Updating we would keep our recorded understanding of a company moving as new evidence arrives, since the investment process is iterative and a view written down two years ago should not still be the view today. Your thesis could focus on one of these, though as a full-time member of the team you will work across several.

Academic Supervision: The Lead of the Data & AI Team is a PhD candidate at TUM's School of Computation, Information and Technology (CIT) and can supervise CIT masters students directly, so there is no separate supervisor search. However, you are free to choose your own supervisor and candidates from other universities bring their own.


What we offer

  • Network: A desk at the Munich Urban Colab, our main office, with the option of a second one in Garching, plus access to the UnternehmerTUM ecosystem of startups, experts, and investors.
  • Team & Culture: Monthly team lunches, our regular Stammtisch, free sports classes, Makerspace access for your personal projects, and regular team events.
  • Compensation: An attractive salary for the full six months of your master thesis or internship.
  • Ownership: Research that is yours end to end and feeds real fund decisions.
  • Equipment: A MacBook or a Windows laptop, whichever you work best on.
  • AI Tooling: Full access to the AI development stack we use daily, and a team that will teach you to use it properly.
  • Real Data: Proprietary venture data that researchers rarely get access to, with the pipelines to use it productively.

Interested?
Please send a one-page CV, a current transcript, and a link to your GitHub or portfolio. Tell us which of these directions interests you most and why. We look forward to hearing from you!


Diversity is important to us

Diversity enriches our team. We explicitly encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of gender, social and ethnic background, sexual orientation, religion, age, or disability.

title: (Junior) Data Scientist
description:
Introduction:

At quantilope, we're transforming how the world's biggest brands understand their customers. As a (Junior) Data Scientist, you'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, and Software Engineers to build and evolve our AI-powered consumer insights platform. From developing agentic AI assistants and advanced analytics to creating innovative research tools usable by non-technical users — you'll be at the heart of scaling a sophisticated platform that puts automated, AI-powered insights into the hands of researchers and brands worldwide.

We are looking for a (Junior) Data Scientist who delivers production-grade results to high standards, who combines a passion for the latest AI technologies with the engineering discipline to ship them reliably, and who brings analytical and creative problem-solving to new challenges.


What you will be doing:

  • You design and build agentic AI systems using frameworks like Pydantic AI, including tool registries, prompt engineering, grounding strategies, and orchestration of LLM-based workflows across multiple AI-powered products

  • You closely collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and work with engineers to integrate AI and Data Science features into our platform

  • You automate data analytics and insights visualizations that are applicable and interpretable by non-technical users, helping researchers and brand managers work with advanced methods without needing technical expertise

  • You automate the application of advanced market research methods that are easy to use while being statistically and scientifically valid

  • You build and ship machine learning models (supervised, unsupervised, LLM-based) end-to-end — from prototyping and training to production deployment in our platform

  • You contribute to our AI observability and evaluation practices, working with tools like Langfuse and inspect-ai to monitor, trace, and continuously improve our AI systems in production

  • You stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI, LLMs, and agentic architectures, incorporate them into your work, and proactively share insights and opportunities with colleagues


Who you are:

  • You have a university degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics or a related relevant field

  • You have at least one year of professional experience in Data Science and AI building production-grade products

  • You have production-level experience building agentic AI systems or LLM-powered applications, including prompt engineering, tool-use patterns, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or similar approaches

  • You have strong programming skills in Python and proficiency with relevant frameworks and libraries (e.g., FastAPI, Pydantic/Pydantic AI, Pytest, Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) as well as experience with LLM integration (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar providers)

  • You have experience in the software industry including delivering high-quality, scalable services via APIs to production

  • You write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code — you're comfortable working in a professional codebase with code reviews, automated testing (e.g., Pytest), and CI/CD practices

  • You are an excellent and creative problem solver who is comfortable with ambiguity and change and who is curious to learn new tools, technologies, and domains

  • You are fluent in English with excellent communication skills — including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and to work effectively in cross-functional teams


Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructure for software deployment (Kubernetes, Helm) and AI observability tooling (Langfuse, LLM tracing)

  • Experience in or passion for the area of market research, marketing, or consumer insights


Benefits of working at quantilope:

  • Flexible work environment: With flexible PTO, flexible working hours and remote/hybrid opportunities, we believe you can succeed from anywhere. Did we mention that everyone has the opportunity to work abroad for up to 6 weeks per year?

  • Ongoing learning: With our dedicated learning budget for every employee and company-wide workshops with the best in the biz, we believe in providing our employees with all the tools they need to excel. 

  • Wellness is key: We offer Private Health Insurance & Pension plan options as well as the support of certified mental health first aiders. We also have Quantiwell days which are global mental health days twice a year where the whole company takes a day for themselves.

  • Diverse & inclusive community: Our team spans the globe, driving diverse ways of working and thinking. With the help of an incredible Community Committee, we are committed to advancing education and awareness.
     
  • Team bonding: Team offsites, summer and holiday parties? We’re all working hard and know how important it is to have fun along the way.

title: Senior Accountant/ Finance Specialist (m/w/d) - remote
description:
Deine Rolle

Du bist unser zentraler Finance Point of Contact - die Person, bei der alle Fäden zusammenlaufen. Du verantwortest das komplette operative Finance, baust dir die Prozesse dafür selbst auf und automatisierst, was sich automatisieren lässt. 

Du bekommst echte Ownership, maximale Autonomie und die Chance, Finance so zu gestalten, wie du es für richtig hältst.

Die Stelle ist zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet. Uns ist eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit wichtig, daher ist eine Verlängerung bzw. Übernahme in eine unbefristete Anstellung angestrebt. 

Aufgaben:

Operatives Finance

  • Kreditoren- & Debitorenbuchhaltung: Rechnungslauf, Belegprüfung, Mahnwesen.

  • Zahlungsverkehr & Banken: Tagesgeschäft, Kontoauszüge, Abstimmungen.

  • Reisekosten & Spesen: Teamausgaben effizient über moderne Tools (z. B. Spendesk).

  • Umsatzabgleich: App Store, Google Play und PayPal mit Kontoeingängen abstimmen.

Steuerberatung & Behörden

  • Zentrale Anlaufstelle und enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Steuerberatungskanzlei.

  • Ansprechperson bei Betriebsprüfungen und Wirtschaftsprüfer-Audits.

Zusammenarbeit mit den Departments

  • Enge Abstimmung mit den Fachbereichen, allen voran Sales: Deal-Abstimmungen, Provisions-/Bonus-Themen, laufender Austausch zu Zahlen.

Payroll & Vergütung

  • Sales-Bonus-Berechnung und Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung vorbereiten, prüfen und freigeben – inkl. internationale Payroll (u. a. Deel).

Abschlüsse & Compliance

  • Mitwirkung an Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB, Budgetierung/Financial Planning.

Prozesse & Systeme

  • Einführung von Scopevisio als neuem Finance-System, Pflege der Stammdaten.

  • Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Prozesse.

Automatisierung & KI

  • Du entscheidest, wo sich Automatisierung wirklich lohnt, und baust entsprechende Schnittstellen zwischen unseren Tools.

  • Aktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools, um wiederkehrende Aufgaben effizienter zu machen.


Was du für diese Rolle brauchst

  • Erfahrung: Mehrjährig, idealerweise als Alleinverantwortliche:r über mehrere Finance-Disziplinen hinweg (Buchhaltung, Payroll, Abschlüsse).

  • Tools: Sicherer Umgang mit gängiger Buchhaltungssoftware wie DATEV ist Pflicht; Erfahrung mit Tools wie Scopevisio, Spendesk oder HubSpot (als CRM/Buchungstool im Zusammenspiel mit Sales) ist von Vorteil.

  • Mindset: Digital- und AI-affin, nutzt KI-Tools aktiv zur Effizienzsteigerung.

  • Arbeitsweise: Selbstständig, proaktiv, mit echtem Ownership.

  • Sprachen: Sehr gutes Deutsch, gutes Englisch.


Warum StudySmarter?

Wir sind längst mehr als eine Lern-App - StudySmarter begleitet Millionen Menschen von der Schule über das Studium bis in den Berufseinstieg. Dabei bewegen wir uns an der Schnittstelle aus Tech, Social Impact und internationalem Wachstum: Wir setzen früh auf neue Technologien, insbesondere KI, und entwickeln Produkt und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter. Du bist Teil eines Teams, das diesen Anspruch jeden Tag in die Praxis übersetzt.

Was du bei uns findest:

  • Remote-first: Arbeite von dort, wo du am produktivsten bist!

  • Ownership statt Mikromanagement: Kurze Wege zum Founder-Team, echte Entscheidungsbefugnis, kein Wasserkopf.

  • Beteiligung am Erfolg: Du wirst am Unternehmenserfolg von StudySmarter beteiligt (Shares).

  • Gesundheit: Firmenrabatt über EGYM Wellpass für dein Training.

  • Team & Kultur: Regelmäßige Teamevents und Ausflüge, ein diverses und ambitioniertes Team.

  • Modernes Büro in München: Hochwertige Ausstattung, Terrasse – falls du doch mal vor Ort sein möchtest.

  • Verpflegung: Frisches Obst, Säfte, Porridge-Bar und eine Getränke-Flatrate im Büro.

  • Ausstattung & Weiterbildung: Wähl dein eigenes Arbeitsequipment, und wir unterstützen dich aktiv bei Schulungen und Weiterbildungen


Deine Bewerbung

Schick uns Deinen CV. Ein Anschreiben ist optional.

Wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung und melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei Dir zurück.

description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence that benefits all of humanity. Our EMEA organization translates OpenAI’s global mission and strategy into meaningful local impact, working across Growth, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Finance, Research, Operations and Compliance.

About the Role

As EMEA Strategy and Operations lead, you will develop country and regional strategies, identify the most important market opportunities and barriers, align cross-functional teams around a focused set of priorities, and personally drive initiatives through to measurable outcomes.

This is an individual-contributor role. The primary focus is Consumer, with opportunities to create adjacent impact across B2B. You will go deep in a small number of priority markets while building approaches that can scale across EMEA.

This is not a strategy-only role. The successful candidate will combine rigorous analysis and market judgment with urgency, hands-on execution and the ability to influence without formal authority.

This role is based in London or Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Build country and regional strategies: Develop plans, priorities and forecasts for key European markets and translate company strategy into practical local action.

  • Drive growth and conversion: Use data, customer insight and experimentation to improve acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion and monetization.

  • Lead market expansion and localization: Identify opportunities, build scalable launch frameworks and determine where products and go-to-market should adapt.

  • Turn strategy into execution: Personally move initiatives from diagnosis and prioritization through delivery, measurement and iteration.

  • Lead cross-functional teams: Align Product, Growth, Marketing, Brand, Partnerships, Finance, Research, Operations and Compliance around shared outcomes.

  • Represent regional insight: Ensure European market and customer perspectives shape global roadmaps and decisions.

  • Measure and scale impact: Define success metrics and determine when a successful local approach should be replicated.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 10 years + of experience in growth, strategy, business operations or quantitative analytics with meaningful responsibility for outcomes.

  • Have developed country, regional or multi-market strategies and translated them into focused execution plans.

  • Bring exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, including forecasting, financial modeling and growth metrics.

  • Can show examples of personally taking initiatives from insight through launch and measurement.

  • Understand European markets while maintaining a regional and scalable perspective.

  • Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders and influence teams without formal authority.

  • Operate with high ownership and urgency in ambiguous, resource-constrained environments.

  • Have a deep interest in AI and alignment with OpenAI’s mission.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

Account-aligned technical and commercial owners retain ongoing account ownership.

We are looking for a driven solutions leader with a product mindset to partner with our international public-sector customers and ensure they achieve tangible value with GenAI. You will pair with government agencies, policymakers, and other public institutions to establish a GenAI strategy and identify the highest value applications. You’ll partner with their technical teams, subject matter experts, regional cloud providers, systems integrators, and implementation partners to move from prototype through production. You’ll design architectures using supported OpenAI technologies and approved services, with explicit data, inference, evaluation, and production-readiness boundaries. You will collaborate closely with regional Sales and Solutions Engineering, Global Affairs, Applied Research, Product, Legal, and Security teams.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Deliver clearly scoped technical implementations with sophisticated international public-sector customers, serving as their hands-on engineering partner to build applications on supported model APIs, Codex, and other approved OpenAI technologies.

  • Work with senior customer stakeholders to identify the best applications of GenAI in their industry and to build/qualify a comprehensive backlog to support their AI roadmap.

  • Intervene directly to accelerate customer time to value through building hands-on prototypes and/or by delivering impactful strategic guidance, often in collaboration with systems integrators and implementation partners.

  • Forge and manage relationships with our customers’ and implementation partners’ leadership and stakeholders to ensure the successful deployment and scale of their applications.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist, London
description:
About Hiya

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

About the Role

This role owns talent acquisition across EMEA end to end, covering GTM and Engineering hiring in the UK, Germany, France, Spain, Italy and the Nordics, with APAC to follow as we expand. It is the first permanent in-house recruiting hire in the region, replacing a contractor model that gave us capacity but no continuity. You will partner daily with hiring managers across EMEA, with HR Operations and onboarding in the US and Europe, and with EMEA sales and engineering leadership.

We're excited about you because you're the kind of person who...

gets energised rather than deterred by pitching a company nobody has heard of yet. You form a view, push back on a brief that will not work, and keep going when response rates are low, without needing a process to be finished before you can work inside it.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own a portfolio of 8 to 12 live roles across EMEA end to end, spanning GTM (Account Directors, Account Executives, SDRs, Customer Success) and Engineering, from intake through to offer and handover.

  • Run intake meetings that turn a vague hiring manager wish list into a defined, sourceable brief, and push back when the brief and the market do not match.

  • Source directly and relentlessly. Most of our best hires will not apply to us, and there is no brand pull to fall back on.

  • Build and hold the market maps, talent pools and competitor intelligence for the countries we hire in, so knowledge compounds inside Hiya rather than leaving with a contract.

  • Pitch Hiya credibly to senior candidates in markets where we have no name recognition, and turn scepticism into genuine interest.

  • Use AI tooling across the whole workflow, from sourcing and research through screening, outreach and reporting, and keep improving how you do it as the tools change.

  • Partner with HR Operations and onboarding across the US and Europe, setting candidate expectations early on the realities of multi-country employment including EOR, so offers do not fall over at contract stage.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of in-house recruiting experience, with hands-on hiring across multiple EMEA countries rather than the UK alone. Agency background is welcome, but you must have owned processes in-house, and be ready to name the countries, the volume and what each market taught you.

  • A genuine all-rounder: you have recruited both commercial and technical roles, and you can hold your own with an engineering hiring manager.

  • A demonstrated track record of identifying and attracting senior talent in a competitive market for a company with no brand recognition. This is the single most important requirement and we will test it live.

title: Talent Lead at AIOS- Remote, $100-200k inc equity
description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $400M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We’re the world’s fastest growing AI doctor.

We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Talent Lead at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team. As Talent Lead at AIOS, your fundamental role is to supercharge our talent (recruiting) function, ensuring that a lack of key hires never blocks growth. You’ll help define what a killer sourcing process looks like while leveraging frontier tooling to increase your throughput and velocity as you recruit best-in-class operators.

You’ll work across a variety of roles: traditional direct-to-consumer Growth roles (Performance Marketing), technical roles (AI + SWE Engineering & Product), and clinical roles — flexing deftly between more junior roles all the way up to the most senior roles in the org.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice — as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday. You’ll have flex in your calendar for kids if you have them — many of our team have kids so we’re kid-friendly.

This is an individual-contributor role — no direct reports, full-cycle sourcing/screening/closing, hands dirty in the trenches. You’ll report directly to Cierra Olsen (Head of Talent).

You’ll also work closely with the rest of the Talent Team: Zoe Wheeler (UK Talent Lead), Mika Mansilla (Founder Associate), and Jordan Pellikan (VP Ops).

Key responsibilities

  • Full cycle: Own searches end to end from sourcing, outbound, screening, interview coordination, calibration, and closing (recent examples: Head of InfoSec, Head of Creative, Senior Media Buyer, Affiliate Lead).

  • Sourcing: Build repeatable sourcing engines for hard-to-fill roles. Run LinkedIn X-ray searches, build target-company lists, and do the outbound headhunting yourself. Our best hires won’t come inbound.

  • Processes: Constantly sharpen our hiring bars (seniority, industry fit, recency, builder pattern) consistently across every search you’re DRI for. Help improve interview processes across the org.

  • Hygiene: Keep pipelines, stages, and candidate communication clean and current in Ashby so nothing stalls and our time to hire continually improves.

  • Calibration: Flag pipeline risk early, bring calibration questions before they become misses, and constantly align with leaders across the org to improve our processes.

  • Closing: Manage candidate experience through to signed offer, including comp conversations.

KPIs

  • Time-to-fill on your owned searches, without sacrificing the bar

  • Sourced (outbound) candidates as a % of your total pipeline — we want you building your own pipeline, not living off inbound

  • Offer-accept rate on closed candidates

  • Ashby pipeline hygiene — stages and candidate status always current

Need to have

  • Excellence: You have 5+ years experience personally recruiting (sourcing, screening, managing, and closing) great candidates across difficult searches. You can point to hires that materially raised the talent bar of the teams they joined.

  • Hunter: You can turn a vague candidate profile into target companies, search strings and a high-quality outbound pipeline. You do not depend on inbound applicants or agencies to fill roles.

  • Senior hiring: You have successfully recruited senior leaders and understand how sourcing, assessing and closing them differs from junior hiring.

  • Judgment: You can distinguish exceptional people from candidates who simply have the right companies, titles or polish on their CV. You develop conviction quickly and can clearly articulate why someone does or does not meet the bar.

  • Range: You can move between very different searches without losing depth. You learn unfamiliar markets quickly enough to recruit credibly within them.

  • Multi-workstream: You can run several searches simultaneously while keeping sourcing quality, candidate communication, follow-ups and pipeline hygiene exceptionally tight.

  • Urgency: You push searches forward without waiting to be managed, surface problems early, and change approach quickly when a pipeline is not working.

  • High bar: You care more about making an exceptional hire than filling a seat, and you are comfortable challenging hiring managers when you do not believe a candidate meets org standards.

Nice to have

  • Startups/Scale-ups: You’ve recruited in a fast-moving startup or scale-up where priorities shift quickly, roles evolve mid-search, and there isn’t always an existing playbook.

  • Technical recruiting: You’ve successfully recruited for Engineering, AI, Data, Product or other technical roles and can credibly assess candidate quality beyond surface-level credentials.

  • Regulated industries: You’ve recruited in healthcare, financial services, or another highly regulated industry where candidate requirements and operating constraints are more complex.

  • AI-native: You actively use AI and automation to improve sourcing, research, outreach, screening, and recruiting operations.

  • Systems builder: You’ve helped build or materially improve recruiting processes, tooling, scorecards, sourcing systems, or interview loops rather than simply operating an existing process.

  • Network: You have an existing network of exceptional operators, builders and leaders you’d be excited to bring into AIOS.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

    🎯 "You just build a f\*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $100k-$200k/yr, incl equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

title: Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer
description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team


Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

 

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.

 

This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. 

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London).

We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors.

You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers.

You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process.

This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing.


Functions of the Role

  • Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices, developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility.

  • Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight, identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping.

  • Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure, creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments.

  • Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift.

  • Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers, providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield.

  • Build scalable characterisation processes, establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams.

  • Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology, bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales.

  • We are looking for someone who combines strong semiconductor device knowledge with a practical, data-driven approach to electrical characterisation.


Experience - Essentials


  • Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Materials Science or a closely related discipline.

  • 3+ years' experience in semiconductor device testing, reliability engineering, electrical characterisation or yield analysis within a foundry, IDM or semiconductor R&D environment.

  • Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows.

  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor parameter analysers, SMUs and wafer probe stations, including DC and/or RF electrical testing.

  • Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution.

  • A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams.


Experience - Desirable

It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in:

  • Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping.

  • Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems.

  • Semiconductor yield improvement, process control or statistical analysis.

  • Automated wafer-level testing and high-throughput characterisation.

  • Working with advanced or emerging semiconductor technologies.


Benefits

  • Be part of a creative, world-leading team

  • Competitive salary and share options scheme

  • Contributory pension scheme

  • Group private medical insurance scheme

  • Life Assurance

  • Cycle-to-work Scheme 

  • Central London location

What you bring

You're a lawyer with real practice experience who has become genuinely technical: maybe you did a coding bootcamp, maybe you taught yourself, but either way you're the person colleagues ask how something actually works. You live in AI tools, and it shows: you can tell a strong use case from a plausible-sounding weak one, you know why a prompt underperforms before you've finished reading it, and you hold both halves of the judgement this role needs: what makes a prompt run well, and what makes a legal output substantively right rather than merely fluent. This role is built to grow with the field itself. DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join DeepL Voice, the team defining the art of the possible for real-time interpretation. While our Translation engine conquered text, Voice is conquering the physical world. We are building the "Universal Translator"; enabling fluid, real-time conversations for frontline workers, global meetings, and enterprise teams.

This is a 0-to-1 engineering environment. We successfully launched our first customer-facing features in late 2024, but we are just getting started. We are tackling the hardest problems in AI interaction: How do you eliminate the "flickering" effect of unstable transcripts? How do you chain chunked inference to achieve sub-millisecond latency? How do you deliver a seamless audio stream that feels natural, not robotic?.

You will work in a dynamic, cross-functional squad alongside Researchers, Product Managers, and Designers. We are not just wrapping an API; we are building the proprietary models, the streaming architecture, and the user interfaces that allow the world to speak without barriers.

Your responsibilities

  • A "0-to-1" Builder Mindset: You thrive in ambiguity. You don't need a roadmap to build; you need a problem. You are comfortable prototyping a new feature in the morning and refactoring it for scale in the afternoon.

  • Product Obsession: You care about the flow of the conversation. You understand that "99% accuracy" means nothing if the audio arrives 3 seconds late. You optimize for the human experience.

  • Ship End-to-End Features: Build and deploy impactful features across the entire stack, from high-performance frontend UIs to streaming audio services on the backend and AI inference integration.

  • Tackle Real-Time Complexity: Debug and resolve challenging edge cases unique to real-time communication, including sub-second latency spikes, transcript flicker, audio glitches, and unstable network environments.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely in a tight-knit, cross-functional squad alongside PMs, Product Designers, and AI Researchers to scope, shape, and solve hard product and technical challenges.


Qualities we look for

  • A "Product-First" Mindset: You care deeply about the customer journey. You ask, "How does this feature help us close the next Enterprise deal?" before writing code.

  • Full-Stack Fluency: You're comfortable across the stack — building polished, modern UI in React and TypeScript on the frontend, and shipping backend services in Node.js/TypeScript (or a strongly transferable language, with willingness to ramp) on the backend.

  • Real-time: WebRTC, WebSockets, streaming architectures, latency-sensitive systems.

  • High Agency: You don't wait for permission. If the billing reconciliation process is slow, you automate it. If the documentation for the API is unclear, you fix it.

  • AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving.


A Note on Our Hiring Process: DeepL hires for the Company, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack .

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

 

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

title: AI Engineer Intern, GenAI Internal Automation (GAIA)
description:
About the team

At Equativ, we're on a mission to develop advertising technologies that empower our customers to reach their digital business goals. The impact of Generative AI on the industry is projected to be major, and Equativ has been undergoing a significant transformation to embed this technology at the core of our value proposition.

The GenAI team is a new, strategic unit (6–8 people) responsible for the design, development, and deployment of Equativ's entire GenAI stack. You will be joining a team of 3 developers and 2 product managers. It is split into two complementary pillars:

  • Core Platform — designing and building a reusable, industrialized Agentic Platform (MaaS, AaaS, Model/Agent as a Service) to accelerate agent development across the company.

  • Business Feature — the team you will be joining. We develop and deploy mission-critical AI agents that automate workflows for non-technical internal teams (operations, ad quality, marketplace, finance support, etc.). Our backlog targets people who today rely on manual processes and ad-hoc tooling, your work will give them autonomous, measurable, production-grade AI assistants.

This team is part of the R&D department (200+ engineers across Paris, Nantes, Limoges, Krakow, Berlin and North America), all working in an Agile environment.


What you will do

  • Create reusable components and libraries (Python + n8n) for the Business Feature Team, leveraging existing workflows and agents to accelerate future development.

  • Perform maintenance (TMA) on existing workflows and agents, focusing on resolving issues and improving performance.

  • Partner directly with non-technical stakeholders, sit with operations teams, understand their pain points, translate workflows into agentic solutions, and explain your design choices.

  • Collaborate with the team on Python development, contributing to the production codebase by applying software engineering principles (unit tests, CI/CD, Git, code review) and helping implement AIOps/AgentOps best practices.


About you

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or similar technical fields.

  • Experience with Python, and using Git for collaboration. You are comfortable working in group projects and collaborating within a team, with a strong desire to learn AIOps/MLOps best practices in a professional environment.

  • Proven experience building production-ready agent workflows with Google ADK (strongly preferred), Langchain, or LangGraph.

  • Practical experience with cloud platforms (Vertex AI, Kubernetes or equivalents) for deploying scalable GenAI services.

  • You can sit down with a non-technical stakeholder, draw out their workflow, and come back with a working agent.

  • Versatile, autonomous, and proactive, you love taking initiatives and driving your projects, with a strong desire to grow while being mentored by our solid team of developers and product managers.

  • Fluent technical English (written and verbal) mandatory.


Practical

  • Status: Internship

  • Location: Paris

  • Working language: English

👋 About us 

Equativ, a leading independent ad platform, brings scale and simplicity to digital advertising.
 
Following its recent merger with Sharethrough and the acquisition of Kamino Retail, advertisers, media owners, and technology partners rely on Equativ’s advanced SSP, curation, and retail media services and technology to achieve maximum business outcomes.
 
With a focus on privacy-first programmatic video, CTV, and data-driven solutions, Equativ enables clients to activate across the digital ecosystem while protecting consumer privacy.
 
The company’s global expertise is also backed by a team of over 750 employees across 19 countries.
 
As a proud recipient of the HappyIndex@Work label, Equativ is committed to providing a dynamic, flexible workplace where employees thrive, grow, and excel in both their professional and personal lives.
Come and lead the charge with us in building a transparent ecosystem based on quality!

title: Director – International Relations and Diplomacy Programs
description:
Your mission

The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. The Director will be responsible for ensuring program currency and curriculum quality, faculty hiring and performance, and achieving student outcomes within the International Relations and Diplomacy discipline. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs.
  
 The role encompasses the oversight of program design, curriculum development, course content, syllabi, course delivery, assessment and continuous improvement processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. accreditation standards, local regulatory requirements, and dual-degree and articulation agreements with various partners. The Director will work closely with academic leaders across campuses to recruit, evaluate, and support faculty teaching International Relations and Diplomacy courses, ensuring consistency in academic standards and learning outcomes throughout the institution. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university.
  
 In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation. 
 
The successful candidate will work closely with faculty, staff, and other university stakeholders to foster student engagement, academic success, preparation for employment and career success, and deliver a transformative, student-centered educational experience aligned with Schiller’s experiential and challenge-based learning model.


Tasks and Responsabilities

  • Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices. 
  • Participate in the review and assessment of program and course learning outcomes for International Relations and Diplomacy and other academic areas.
  • Engage actively in innovation within the area(s) of knowledge to update teaching and learning methodologies and educational technology in collaboration with the Educational Technology team and industry professionals.
  • Assess instructional needs and lead the effort to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all International Relations and Diplomacy courses across campuses in collaboration academic leaders on other campuses in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with academic leaders on other campuses to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all courses on the Paris campus in a timely manner.
  • Lead annual evaluations of faculty in IRD across campuses and contribute to faculty annual performance evaluations at the Paris campus. 
  • Conduct course observations as needed, both online and onsite. 
  • Collaborate with the Educational Technology team to offer faculty development activities.
  • Support the growing Distance Learning Master’s program in International Relations and Diplomacy.
  • Collaborate with Dean of Institutional Effectiveness to ensure program quality and compliance with all regulations and accreditation requirements. 
  • Monitor student outcomes data weekly and to identify students at risk. Work with faculty and student services to design interventions to support their retention and success.
  • Collaborate with Employability team and devise and implement measures and initiatives to boost students’ employability and career success. 
  • Coordinate the effective implementation of VLE templates and uniform content within International Relations and Diplomacy offerings.
  • Manage faculty workload and faculty assignment in collaboration with the other academic leaders.
  • Any other duties assigned by the Provost, President or Campus Director.


Your Profile

  • An earned Doctorate degree in International Relations and Diplomacy or related field from an accredited institution or close to completion.
  • Proven experience and demonstrated excellence in higher education, administration, and industry experience.
  • Academic program design and review and managing faculty and staff.
  • Passion and commitment to student support and success.
  • Knowledge and experience in distant leaning and online instruction.
  • Knowledge of the American and/or French higher education systems is a plus.
  • Either native English speaker or proficiency level of English competency
  • Local language (French, German, Spanish), desirable
Competencies
  • Communication Connection and Service 
  • Global Mindset 
  • Achieving Results 
  • Driving Innovation and Managing Change 
  • Learning and Development 
  • Drives Vision and Leads Courageously
  • Strong focus on quality and continuous improvement 
  • Leadership skills 
  • Strong intercultural communication skills and cultural agility

title: Senior Creative Strategist (all genders)
description:

Wir schaffen Relevanz, um Aufmerksamkeit zu erreichen und zu skalieren.

Sichtbarkeit ist nicht automatisch Relevanz. Reichweite nicht automatisch Wirkung.

WeCreate ist eine Social-First Brand Building Agency für das Interest-Media-Zeitalter. Wir übersetzen Social Signals und Community Insights in Social Strategien, Content-Systeme und messbare Markenwirkung – als strategischer Partner, Campaign Co-Pilot oder operatives Umsetzungsteam. 

Für Marken, die nicht nur stattfinden, sondern kulturell und in ihren Communities relevant sein wollen, suchen wir dich als Senior Creative Strategist (all genders).

Du verbindest strategische Klarheit mit kreativer Führung. Als strategische Stimme von WeCreate entwickelst du die Marken- und Plattformlogik unserer Kund:innen, übersetzt sie in wirksame Content-Systeme und stellst sicher, dass aus einer guten Idee ein konsistenter, relevanter und plattformnativer Content-Output wird.


Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest die strategische und kreative Gesamtausrichtung komplexer Kunden-Mandate von der Social Marken-Positionierung über Plattform- und Kanalstrategien bis zur übergreifenden Content-Systematik und Qualitätssicherung über alle Projektphasen hinweg.

Dabei arbeitest du eigenständig auf Senior-Level, triffst Entscheidungen mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum und kommunizierst sicher mit den Marken-Entscheider:innen. Du führst Creative Reviews, moderierst Sparrings-Formate und gibst Kund:innen sowie internen Teams Orientierung, wenn strategische, kreative oder operative Fragen zusammenkommen.

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der integrierten Arbeit mit dem Team: Mindestens fünf Tage pro Monat arbeitest du im WeCreate-Office in Hamburg. Zusätzlich bringst du die notwendige Flexibilität für Produktionen, Workshops, Kundentermine und Offsite-Formate mit auch dann, wenn diese außerhalb deines üblichen Arbeitsortes stattfinden.


Dein Impact bei WeCreate

Du gibst Marken und Teams Richtung. Du sorgst dafür, dass strategische Klarheit nicht in Präsentationen endet, sondern in kreativen Systemen, relevanten Inhalten und konsistenter Markenwirkung sichtbar wird.

Du verbindest die Perspektiven von Kund:innen, Creative Studio, Beratung, Produktion und Plattformen. Dabei bist du mehr als Ideengeber:in. Du entwickelst die Logik hinter der Arbeit, führst durch komplexe Entscheidungen und stellst sicher, dass Qualität über alle Projektphasen hinweg erkennbar bleibt.

Als Senior Creative Strategist stärkst du nicht nur einzelne Kundenprojekte, sondern auch die strategische und kreative Kompetenz von WeCreate als Organisation.


Das erwartet dich:

  • Strategische und kreative Gesamtverantwortung: Du führst komplexe Kunden-Mandate ganzheitlich von digitaler Markenpositionierung, Plattform- und Kanalstrategie bis zur kreativen Leitidee und belastbaren Umsetzungslogik.
  • Seniorige Kunden- und Teamführung: Du präsentierst Strategien und Kreativkonzepte überzeugend, moderierst Sparrings-Formate und führst interdisziplinäre Teams zu klaren, tragfähigen Entscheidungen.
